subject: Post-demo synthesis: inference contrast + proposed tests
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-10T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Quick synthesis & next tests after today's demo

Alex — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Two quick notes to capture what we discussed and propose a lightweight, measurable follow-up plan so your engineering and procurement teams have what they need to compare Redwood vs HyperscalerX: 

1) Differentiation summary (what you told us mattered):
- Consistent 99th pct latency at 2k context for live requests
- Small tail-regression risk on long-context multi-turn chat
- Cost-in-production (tokens + infra ops) vs managed hyperscaler endpoints

2) Proposed evaluation pillars (what we'll deliver):
- Throughput/latency matrix for 128, 512, 2k contexts (p50/p95/p99) across model variants
- Hallucination/regression checks on your seeded prompt set (we'll run before/after quant/ops)
- Failover/fallback behavior (how Redwood routes to smaller variants when capacity scarcer)

3) Deliverables and timing:
- Contrast matrix spreadsheet (attached) with the metrics we'll collect — ETA: 48 hours for the initial run
- Eval prompt suite (attached sample) — we'll run two sweep passes and share raw outputs + diff highlights — ETA: 72 hours

Next steps from you: please confirm the dataset/ prompt file you want us to run (upload to the shared Drive link or reply with a sample). Also confirm whether you're okay with us provisioning a short dedicated evaluation window (2--4 hours) against our dedicated pool; that gives a stable baseline vs noisy shared endpoints.

I'll loop Ben and Marissa for the technical/ops plan — Ben will coordinate scheduling, Marissa will own the eval definitions.

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-hyperscaler-contrast-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), eval-prompt-suite-v1.jsonl (prompt examples)
From: Alex Nguyen <alex@bluepeak.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: BluePeak AI (evaluation team) <eval-team@bluepeak.ai>
Date: 2027-11-11T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick synthesis & next tests after today's demo

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifying points from our infra/MLQA side before we lock the run window: 

- For the latency matrix, can you include both cold-start and warmed-KV-cache numbers? We need to understand steady-state vs first-burst behavior (we saw some variability from HyperscalerX on cold starts).
- Hallucination/regression checks: we'll provide a 500-line seed set with a mixture of real customer transcripts and synthetic probes. Is that fine? We want to preserve PII redaction — we'll scrub or share via the secure Drive link.
- Can Redwood run the sweep using both your hosted API and a Dedicated short window so we can compare variance between modes? 

Also budget/contract question — procurement asked if you can outline any standard evaluation credits or short-term trial pricing if we run dedicated capacity for 2--3 days. That will help estimate OpEx for the test.

If that's all OK, we'll upload the seed set to the Drive by EOD tomorrow.

— Alex
Alex Nguyen
Head of Machine Learning, BluePeak AI
alex@bluepeak.ai

On Thu, Nov 11, 2027 at 08:12 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (previous message)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@bluepeak.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-12T13:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick synthesis & next tests after today's demo — technical plan

Alex — thanks for the signal. Quick technical plan to answer your asks and keep the sweep small but meaningful: 

- Test matrix: for each mode (Hosted, Dedicated) and for three sequence lengths (128, 512, 2048) we'll run 10k requests sampled from your seed set where applicable. For cold-starts we'll restart model workers between short runs to capture first-token latency; for warmed cache we'll run longer sustained batches to capture p95/p99 under steady-state.

- KV/cache variance: we'll capture per-request KV hit-rate and include a trimmed-mean analysis; this will show how often long-history lookups affect latency.

- Hallucination/regression checks: we'll run the seed set with two temperature settings (0.0 deterministic + 0.7 stochastic) and compute: factuality pass rate (automated checks), hallucination flags (probe prompts), and a human spot-check sample (10% random). We'll highlight any prompt-level regressions vs HyperscalerX baseline.

- Failure/fallback: we'll simulate capacity pressure by throttling one pool and observe Redwood's automatic fallback to compatible variant plus the routing latency added by fallback.

Operational items: 
- We can provision a 4-hour Dedicated window on Wed 11/17 (PST) — that should be sufficient for the initial runs. If you prefer earlier, we can push a 2-hour window tomorrow but results will be noisier.
- Trial credits: Ben has the pricing options (Ben — see suggested short-term promo below).

Ben — propose we offer BluePeak a limited eval discount covering the Dedicated window + hosted token credits to offset processing. Suggested promo: 50% off Dedicated-hour pricing for the first 8 hours + $5k hosted credits for evaluation outputs. Happy to adjust.

Alex — once you confirm the upload location (the Drive link Jasmine shared) and the desired window, we'll lock it in and I’ll circulate a minimal mutual action plan with dates and owners.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Applied ML, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Mutual action plan (summary):
- You: upload the 500-line seed set to this Drive folder by 2027-11-15 EOD (BluePeak -> drive link).
- Redwood: provision a 4-hour Dedicated window on 2027-11-17 10:00–14:00 PST and run the full sweep (Hosted + Dedicated).
- Redwood deliverables: contrast matrix + raw outputs + prompt-level regression highlights by 2027-11-18 EOD.
- Commercial offer: Ben will send a trial promo (Dedicated discount + $5k hosted credits) in a separate email to procurement.

I'm attaching the contrast matrix and the prompt sample again for your convenience. If the dates look tight on your side we can move the Dedicated window a day later.

Thanks — looking forward to the results.

— Jasmine
